semantic_summary.one_sentence_summary: The recording consists of 40 vocal phrases classified into 4 phrase types with notably variable durations and pauses, organized into 8 recurring melodic motifs that predominantly exhibit descending or mostly flat pitch contours around a tonal center near A#3, and an overall ascending pitch drift.
semantic_summary.structure_description: Phrases include extended (17), standard (12), compact (4), and short vocal calls (7). Pauses are mostly short or micro-pauses, with few long or extended silences, leading to high vocal density (~94%) and low silence density (~5%). Phrase durations have a high variance from very short (~0.37s) to long (~24s). The vocal cycle tempo is approximately 19.7 phrase cycles per minute, though with low stability and confidence. Eight motifs cluster repeated phrase contours, mostly descending or stable in pitch, covering 87% of phrases.
semantic_summary.dominant_pattern: The dominant patterns are melodic motifs with descending or flat pitch contours around tonal center A#3 (230.4 Hz), with repeated occurrence of extended phrases having durations upwards of 10 seconds, interspersed with short vocal calls and pauses, creating a flexible but repetitive vocal cycle lacking stable metrical beat.
uncertainty_notes: Vocal cycle tempo has low confidence and stability due to free rhythm nature.
Pitch stability is moderate (0.769), with an upward pitch drift over the recording.
